dek: The founder and chairman of mainland jewellery maker, Laopu Gold, said he's confident that a recent rebound in bullion prices would boost the company's financial results in the second half of 2026. The comments by Xu Gaoming came after the firm on Tuesday reported an 88.2 percent jump in interim net profit to 4.27 bill
